entities.name: Louis Frédéric Wickham
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Frédéric Wickham was a French physician and pathologist remembered for describing Wickham striae. He trained in medicine in Paris, receiving his M.D. in 1890. He studied dermatology at the Hôpital Saint-Louis in Paris before becoming physician at the Hôpital Saint-Lazare in 1897. After 1905 he worked on research into radium.

entities.summary: Louis Frédéric Wickham was a French physician and pathologist remembered for describing Wickham striae. He trained in medicine in Paris, receiving his M.D. in 1890. He studied dermatology at the Hôpital Saint-Louis in Paris before becoming physician at the Hôpital Saint-Lazare in 1897. After 1905 he worked on research into radium.
